title: Dashboard
demoBanner: Interactive prototype prepared by OctavoLab. Nothing real is sent, charged or published. Sample data.
brandTagline: Order, pay and track in one place
loginSubtitle: Use the email and password of your account.
loginHeroTitle: Your prices, your orders, one secure place.
loginHeroBody: Prices come straight from your account, every order is protected against duplicates and payments run through a certified provider.
loginHeroPoint2: No double orders, even on a weak connection
mfaSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfaRecoveryHint: Each recovery code works only once.
recoveryRemaining: You signed in with a recovery code. {count} codes left: generate new ones in Security.
err_RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
err_RATE_LIMITED_SECONDS: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
err_MFA_INVALID_CODE: That code is not valid. Check the time on your phone and try again.
err_MFA_CHALLENGE_INVALID: Your verification step expired. Sign in again.
err_UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
err_SESSION_REVOKED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
err_MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED: Set up two-step verification to continue.
err_UNKNOWN_SKU: A product in your cart is no longer available. Review the cart.
err_MIXED_CURRENCY: All products in one order must use the same currency.
err_DUPLICATE_SKU: A product appears twice in the cart.
err_IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: This request changed while it was being sent. Try again.
err_INVALID_STATE: This order can no longer be paid.
err_CONFLICT: Something changed at the same time. Try again.
err_NETWORK: No connection to the server. Check your connection and try again.
err_MFA_NOT_CONFIGURED: Two-step verification is not configured on the server yet. Contact your administrator.
catalogEmpty: There are no products available yet.
catalogError: We could not load the catalog.
cartEmpty: Your cart is empty. Add products from the catalog.
mixedCurrency: Your cart mixes currencies. Keep products of one currency to check out.
orderPriceNote: Final prices are confirmed by the server when you place the order.
demoPaymentBody: This environment runs in demo mode. No card is requested and nothing is charged. Your order is registered and waiting for payment confirmation.
stripeSecure: Card details go directly to Stripe, a certified payment provider. We never see them.
stripeLoadError: The payment form could not load. Try again or contact support.
paymentSubmitted: Payment submitted. The order status updates when the provider confirms it.
ordersError: We could not load your orders.
productsSubtitle: Price list of your account. Customers only see active products.
productsReadOnly: Your role can view products but not edit them.
productsEmpty: No products yet. Create the first one.
productsError: We could not load the products.
skuHint: Letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore. It cannot change later.
name: Name
invalidSku: Use 1 to 64 letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.
invalidPrice: Enter a positive price with at most {digits} decimals.
securitySubtitle: Protect your staff account with an authenticator app.
securityRequired: Your account must set up two-step verification before using the rest of the app.
mfaStep1Body: Open your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy or similar) and scan this code.
mfaQrAlt: QR code to add {issuer} to your authenticator app
mfaManual: Can't scan? Enter this key manually
mfaStep2Body: Type the 6-digit code your app shows now.
recoveryBody: Each code lets you sign in once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now: store them somewhere safe.
recoveryFileHeader: Recovery codes for {issuer}. Each code works once. Generated {date}.
recoveryConfirm: I stored my recovery codes in a safe place
recoveryRegenerateBody: Old codes stop working. Confirm with a code from your authenticator app.
notFoundView: This section is not available for your account.
